title: Fixed Swivel V Clamp and Horizontal Notching Spindle
description: One newly authored whole empty bench-mounted tube-notching fixture exterior. A complete low rectangular mounting sole carries a left circular swivel-style seat with an open V saddle and raised opposing clamp pad, a tall one-piece side C arm, vertical clamp spindle and transverse stopped handle. To its right a short separate swivel-style pedestal supports two bearing housings and one long horizontal spindle ending in a genuinely hollow short cup with coarse blunt shallow rim notches. A complete back disc joins cup to shaft. A front locking grip and rear exposed drive-end form complete the fixture; no external hand drill or workpiece is included. Not a renamed chain pipe vise, vertical magnetic core drill or V-table corner-notch press. All geometry coordinates newly authored, not an exact branded replica. One whole static model zero scenes. No rotation, clamp motion, threading engagement, feed motion, drill compatibility, cutting, fixturing capacity, angle calibration, engineering, manufacturing, load or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
